verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair axis for a game engine, but the evidence pack never mentions Summer Engine's license, royalties, revenue share or per-install fees. The only nearby claim, 'set your price', is about pricing a game and says nothing about what the engine takes. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns
